operators.name: custom_abs_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step_001 output: [batch, height, width]

semantics: Computes element-wise absolute value: output[i] = |x[i]| for all elements.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and strides (output is a new tensor with same properties).
No broadcasting or reduction; purely elementwise.

operators.name: custom_softmax_dim1_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step_002 input: [batch, height, width]

semantics: Computes softmax along dimension 1 (height) for a 3D tensor [batch, height, width].
For each batch b and spatial index w, softmax over h = 0..height-1: output[b,h,w] = exp(x[b,h,w]) / sum_{h'} exp(x[b,h',w]).
Uses numerically stable computation (subtract max along dim 1 before exp).
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and strides (output is a new tensor with same properties).
Element-wise absolute value on GPU float32 tensor.
Output shape [128, 8192, 32], dtype float32, device cuda:0, strides [262144, 32, 1].
Softmax along dimension 1 (size 8192) for each (batch, width) pair.
Output shape [128, 8192, 32], dtype float32, device cuda:0, strides [262144, 32, 1].
Returns the softmax result tensor; same as step_002 output.
